periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal orientation relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering medially toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with a vertical length approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lower muzzle, creating an asymmetrical teardrop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape curvature along the posterior edge of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering approximately 35% of the visible torso length along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Substantial gap between ears, estimated at roughly 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the superior edges of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Large brown rectangular object held within the mouth; visible white keratinized claws on the fore and hind paws.
